fields.title: Credentials Selection
fields.description: Select the credentials flow variables for which to extract properties.

fields.title: Fail if selected credentials have no user name set
fields.description:
Select this to prevent execution of subsequent nodes in case the selected credentials have
no user name set. This is useful to avoid failures or unauthorized requests.

fields.title: Fail if selected credentials have no password set
fields.description:
Select this to prevent execution of subsequent nodes in case the selected credentials have
no password set. This is useful to avoid failures or unauthorized requests.

fields.title: Fail if selected credentials have no second authentication factor set
fields.description:
Select this to prevent execution of subsequent nodes in case the selected credentials have
no second authentication factor set. This is useful to avoid failures or unauthorized requests.
